description: This file defines a client for making API requests to a backend, including helper functions for URL building, query parameter handling, and specific API endpoints such as listing users, sessions, deployments, and costs. It also provides a minimal axios-like interface.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Detects if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: buildUrl
methods.description: Constructs a full URL by joining a base URL with a relative path or URL, handling special cases like /api paths and absolute URLs.

methods.name: toQuery
methods.description: Builds a query string from an object of parameters, handling arrays and nested objects.

methods.name: isSessionTrackingRoot
methods.description: Checks if a given path or URL is the root of session-tracking API endpoint.

methods.name: sanitizeEndpointParams
methods.description: Sanitizes query parameters based on specific API endpoint rules, such as restricting allowed params.

methods.name: ensureScopedQueryParams
methods.description: Ensures query parameters include necessary scope identifiers like organization_id or tenant_id based on endpoint.

methods.name: buildUrlWithParams
methods.description: Merges additional parameters into a URL, handling existing query strings.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses fetch response, returning ok, status, and payload (JSON or text).

methods.name: httpGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request with URL building, parameter sanitization, and response parsing.

methods.name: httpJson
methods.description: Performs an HTTP request with JSON body, handling method, URL, parameters, and response.

methods.name: normalizeListPayload
methods.description: Normalizes list responses to an object with items, total, and meta.
